Project 2 · Lesson 2.4
Transactions and commit messages

Many statements, one snapshot

a transaction (DuckDB SQL)
BEGIN; INSERT INTO eth_lake.raw.blocks SELECT … ; CALL eth_lake.set_commit_message('Nuri', 'Load blocks for 1 Nov'); COMMIT;
Studio's SQL Editor runs one statement at a time. We set a commit message live from dbt in Lesson 6.3.
